title: StemStudio fake-backend agent script 1.0.0
description: Scripted model turns for ScriptedChatClient (STEMSTUDIO_AGENT_BACKEND=fake, STEMSTUDIO_AGENT_FAKE_SCRIPT=e2e/agent-scripts/<name>.json) and for unit tests. Turn i answers the i-th model request of a run; a request beyond the last turn fails the run. Names and arguments are not validated here: the runner's registry and policy treat them exactly like a real model's output. Every run plays the script from turn 1; undo runs request no model turn. String argument values may contain these placeholders, each as the whole value: {{context.trackId}}, {{context.mixId}} and {{context.lyricsId}} (023), which the fake backend replaces with the page context of the message that started the run (server-generated ids; empty when absent); {{result.<tool>.ids:<category>}} (023), replaced per turn by a JSON array of the suggestionIds of the items with that category in the run's most recent <tool> result (empty array when there are none; a script error when the run has no earlier call of <tool> or <tool> is not a supported list tool - today only list_lyric_suggestions). Any other {{...}} text passes through unchanged.
